description:
Company Overview

Founded in 2015, PHIL is a Series D healthtech growth-stage startup that is building a platform that interfaces between doctors, pharmacies, and patients to streamline the process of patients receiving prescription medication. This is a traditionally complex, archaic industry, and we've set out to change that through our digitally-enabled direct-to-patient hub and fulfillment platform. PHIL uniquely combines a digitally-enabled hub and pharmacy model to help patients access medication more quickly, affordably, and consistently over their treatment journey.

PHIL's B2B2C platform provides an end-to-end prescription management and delivery service for pharma manufacturers. Our robust platform connects patients, prescribers, pharmacies, and manufacturers, enabling easy and affordable access to medicine. Through PHIL's digital stakeholder experiences, patient access services, market access solutions, and distribution models, pharma manufacturers can deliver affordable and timely therapy access to patients, resulting in more patients staying on their treatment plans longer. Consequently, pharma manufacturers are enabled for more innovation and more patients are able to access the therapy they need.

The team at PHIL is a group of like-minded individuals from varying backgrounds, passionate about creating a new and innovative healthcare platform that is focused on patient experience and overall human wellbeing. Patients love our platform, as evidenced by our top Trustpilot rating (https://www.trustpilot.com/review/phil.us), and pharma manufacturers increasingly put their trust in PHIL to optimize their brands' commercialization strategy. Ready to join our team of mission-driven, analytical, and passionate people? Keep reading!

Position Overview

PHIL is seeking a Vice President of Business Development and GTM Strategy to join our Revenue team. Reporting to the SVP, Business Development, you will lead our most important pharma opportunities from first conversation to launch, grow the partnerships we already have with pharma manufacturers and ecosystem players, and help shape how PHIL goes to market.

This is a high-impact, high-visibility role with real ownership. You will work directly with senior leaders at pharma manufacturers and across PHIL's leadership team, and you will see the direct effect of your work in how many patients start and stay on the therapies they need. The pace is fast and the scope is broad: one day you may be shaping a proposal, the next building a partner relationship or sharpening our positioning. If you love both thinking strategically and winning business, and you want to help build a company that is reshaping how patients get their medicine, we'd love to meet you.

Responsibilities

  1. Lead deals end to end: own key new-business opportunities and RFPs from discovery through scoping, proposal, and negotiation, and hand off cleanly to implementation.

  2. Grow existing partnerships: serve as the business-development lead for select existing pharma customers, bringing new drugs and new capabilities onto the PHIL platform.

  3. Design the solution: turn each client's needs into a clear, differentiated PHIL solution, and build the proposals, presentations, and ROI models that make the case.

  4. Shape our go-to-market: help define positioning, competitive differentiation, and therapeutic-area approach.

  5. Build our ecosystem: develop partnerships and advisor relationships that open doors with pharma manufacturers.

  6. Represent PHIL: speak for the company at industry events and in partner and customer settings.

  7. Work across PHIL: partner with account management, implementation, product, and operations, and help raise the bar for how we work.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

  • Substantial experience in client-facing roles across business development, sales, consulting, partnerships, or strategy.

  • Experience working at, consulting for, or selling to pharmaceutical manufacturers.

  • Experience in strategy or consulting, including building frameworks, presentations, and financial or ROI models.

  • A track record of selling: owning deals, projects, or engagements through to close.

  • Executive presence and comfort working with senior client leaders.

  • Ability to travel regularly.

What makes an outstanding candidate

  • Experience leading, mentoring, or developing others, in any function.

  • Comfort in startup or fast-changing environments, and a bias toward ownership.

  • Experience building partnerships, alliances, or advisor networks.

  • Willingness to roll up your sleeves across proposals, analysis, and operations.

Nice to have (we will teach the rest)

  • Familiarity with hubs, prior authorization, and pharmacy distribution.

  • Experience representing a company at industry conferences and events.

Benefits

  • Ground-floor opportunity with a fast-moving, growth-stage healthtech company.

  • Fully remote working environment.

  • Competitive compensation (commensurate with experience).

  • Full benefits (medical, dental, vision).

  • 401(k) contribution opportunity.

PHIL Inc. is an equal-opportunity employer.
